```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(emplikDTA)
library(rgl)
```


# Simulated data
```{r}
mu_true <- c(0, 2.5, 3.69)
sigma_true <- c(1, 1.1, 1.2)

n1 <- 30
n2 <- 30
n3 <- 30

X1 <- rnorm(n1, mu_true[1], sigma_true[1])
X2 <- rnorm(n2, mu_true[2], sigma_true[2])
X3 <- rnorm(n3, mu_true[3], sigma_true[3])
```

## Plot ROC surface

```{r}
ROC_emp_surface(X1, X2, X3, color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5)
rgl::rglwidget(
    width = 800,
    height = 800
)
```


```{r}
CR_emp_tcfs(X1, X2, X3, cpts = c(0.5, 3.4), fill = TRUE)
rgl::rglwidget(width = 800, height = 800)
```
